tools.name: view_page_as_ai_crawler

tools.name: explain_ai_crawler
tools.description: Explains what an AI crawler user agent does (operator, purpose, and what blocking it in robots.txt changes). Pass a name such as GPTBot or OAI-SearchBot, or omit it to list all crawlers Siteiz tracks.

tools.name: get_ai_visibility_report
tools.description: Returns a published, dated Siteiz AI visibility report for a well-known company's homepage (score, grade, pillar scores, top issues). Omit the company to list all published reports.
